project_members_base.name: project_members_base
project_members_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  member_name,
  member_role,
  project,
  institution_id,
  country,
  activity_type,
  member_short_name,
  member_name AS member_name, /* duplicate alias required by spec */
  unics_id
FROM project_members
project_members_base.description: One row per project member, exposing raw member attributes and foreign keys for joins and filtering.

projects_base.name: projects_base
projects_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program
FROM
  projects p
projects_base.description: One row per project, exposing identifiers and key descriptors used for filtering and joins (acronym, unics_id, title, start/end years).
